name: Muslim Legal Fund of America
mission: MLFA is a community-centric grassroots non-profit organization fighting for national security reform, upholding and establishing justice in our courtrooms and communities for Muslims in America. MLFA is the leading nonprofit legal fund dedicated to defending Muslims’ civil rights and liberties at the federal level.
theoryOfChange: MLFA serves to protect and defend the rights of the American Muslim community and others facing discrimination by engaging in litigation, national security injunctions, and nonprofit legal screenings and consultations. Through litigating cases, MLFA aims to set legal precedent and create 'good law.'

rich_narrative.summary: The Muslim Legal Fund of America (MLFA) defends the constitutional rights of Muslims in the United States through specialized legal defense, civil rights advocacy, and strategic litigation <cite id="4">in criminal, civil, and immigration cases</cite>. Founded in 2001, the organization addresses systemic legal challenges, funding defense litigation and training leaders to safeguard community institutions <cite id="6">against overreach</cite>. In FY2024, MLFA reported <cite id="5">a total revenue of $4,046,006</cite> and directed <cite id="5">$2,578,741 to program services</cite>, reflecting a <cite id="5">69.7% program expense ratio</cite>. While its program expense ratio sits below the 75% industry standard, MLFA maintains strong operational resilience with <cite id="1">5.3 months of working capital</cite> and <cite id="1">a 93/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. MLFA is also <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite>, allowing donors to support legal defense for eligible individuals and institutions.
